heroTitle: Have a fanbase? Start your show.
heroBody: Your skill, your story, your time — invite fans and take bookings on your terms.
heroTicket: Your page. Your price. Your people.
liveTitle: Turn your livestream into an event.
liveBody: A live class, watch party, rehearsal, puja — add a ticket, open the room, meet your fans.
oneTitle: Your time, one fan at a time.
oneBody: Open slots for an online video meetup. Advice, practice, stories or one focused conversation.
showcaseTitle: What happens on screen can become a connection.
showcaseBody: Music, makeup, gaming, recipes, dance, devotion — people are already watching. Give them a room.
meetupBody: Set your availability, explain the format, and keep expectations clear before every booking. Online only, always.
meetupNote: Online video meetups, with clear boundaries.
ideaOneBody: Choreography breakdowns, live practice, feedback calls.
ideaTwoBody: Recipe live streams, street-food stories, kitchen hacks.
ideaThreeBody: Revision sprints, language practice, exam pep talks.
ideaFourBody: Draping tutorials, outfit ideas, live styling streams.
journeyTitle: From channel to first booking in four steps.
stepTwoBody: Set your ticket or call price.
stepThreeBody: Share your avaTOK link with your audience.
stepFourBody: Go live from the avaTOK app.
bookingTitle: What does booking look like for a fan?
bookingBody: One clear page. One date. One seat. After payment, they get the route to the room.
calcBody: Change the inputs to see what paid live streams or 1:1 video calls could gross.
calcDisclaimer: Illustrative gross before platform fees, taxes, refunds and other costs. Not a promise of earnings.
calcPricingNote: Planning example in INR; actual listing pricing and checkout quotes follow the current pricing guide.
faqOneQ: Do I need a big following?
faqOneA: No. Start with one useful offer and share it with people who already care about your work.
faqTwoA: No. Live events and 1:1 sessions happen online. Keep your listing and expectations specific.
faqThreeA: Payout timing and eligible methods are shown in your creator dashboard and the applicable terms.
faqFourQ: Can I set my own boundaries?
faqFourA: Yes. Choose your format, availability, price and what the session includes before publishing.
closeTitle: Put a ticket on your voice.
closeBody: Write one offer today. Open your first room tomorrow.
